newsitem.title: USA: Oceaneering to make five more Hydra units.
newsitem.headline: Oceaneering to make five more Hydra units.

text.p: Oceaneering International Inc said Tuesday its board had approved the construction of five more units of its Hydra MAGNUM work class vehicle, used for underwater work especially in oil and gas drilling.
Oceaneering said it would build the units at its Morgan City, Louisiana facility for delivery between April and June 1997.
It said it was building more of them to meet rising market demand.
"These five vehicles raise the total number of new fleet expansion vehicles we have announced since last December to 22, a 44-percent increase in the size of our work class fleet," it said.
Oceaneering specializes in applied technology, offering services and making vehicles and other products for companies that work in harsh environments like space and the ocean.
